dedupe_keys.name: lao population and housing census 2015 village indicators from the lao statistics bureau republished by open development laos as xlsx and shapefile with main roof wall and floor type water source toilet cooking energy and share of households with electricity for 8 499 villages

description: The Lao Statistics Bureau ran the fourth Population and Housing Census in March 2015, and Open Development Laos republishes a village indicator table from it on the OD Mekong Datahub. The XLSX file has 8,499 village rows in 146 districts and 18 provinces, with English and Lao names and codes, and a Meta sheet that labels each column and names the Lao Statistics Bureau as data owner. Housing and service columns give the main roof, floor and wall type, main water source, main toilet type and main cooking energy in each village, the average living area per person and the percentage of households having electricity. Other columns cover population, age, education, ethnicity, farmland and a poverty estimate. Coverage is national. Format and access: free XLSX, zipped shapefile and WMS layers, no registration; the English national report is on the UNFPA site. Licence: License not specified in the datahub record. Caveats: housing columns give the main type only, not the full distribution; results of the 2025 census were still being processed; the LSB statistics database could not be opened from the cloud because its server uses a weak key. Simulation uses: village electrification and building material for rural energy and flood exposure studies. Related records: the OD Mekong regional hydropower dams dataset and the WorldPop population grid.
